description: A React component named UsersPage that displays a list of users, fetched from an API, with options to view user projects via a modal dialog. The component manages state for user items, loading status, errors, and modal visibility, utilizing hooks like useState, useEffect, and useMemo.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches user data using the listUsers API function, updates state with the fetched items, and manages loading/error states.
